literal_meaning: চোখ বা দৃষ্টি রাখা (to keep the eye or gaze)
figurative_meaning_en: To keep supervision; to pay special attention
example_sentences_in_bangla: কাজের গতির দিকে একটু নজর রেখো।
শিশুটিকে নজরে রেখো যাতে সে বিপদে না পড়ে।
example_sentences_in_english: Keep an eye on the progress of the work.
Keep an eye on the child so that he doesn't get into trouble.
note: The idiom derives from the concept of vigilance, common in everyday Bengali usage without specific historical ties.
